_comment: Hand-researched draft-day notes, keyed by ESPN player id. tone: warn | good. Surfaced in the extension's explain card and as a row badge.

3139477.note: Tore ACL and LCL Dec 2025. Week 1 is 2 days shy of his 9-month recovery mark and Andy Reid will not commit him. Projection assumes a full healthy season.

4427366.note: Mid-August groin injury plus the coach wants a three-back committee. Volume case is weaker than the projection.

4870808.note: High ankle sprain, out for preseason, team only hoping for Week 1. High ankles linger.

3040151.note: On PUP with a torn Achilles - misses at least 4 games. Only draftable as an IR-slot stash AFTER you have a real TE.

5083076.note: Falling after the Browns named Deshaun Watson starter.

3045147.note: Possibly third on the depth chart behind Love and Allgeier; has not resumed 11-on-11. Do not draft.

3117251.note: Questionable; missed over a week with tightness the team is managing. Long injury history.

4685278.note: Missed preseason with a groin injury. Risky at ADP - Rome Odunze benefits.

3043078.note: Age-32 season. No RB since 2000 has averaged 16 ppg at 32+, only three managed 14. Volume is safe, efficiency is the risk.

4567048.note: Zach Charbonnet tore his ACL in January - Walker owns the entire KC backfield. Market has not fully repriced this. Best value on our board.

4361579.note: Re-signed by Dallas, projected for genuine workhorse volume (~1,280 rush yds, 15 total TD).

4890973.note: Kubiak wide-zone scheme fits him; staff targeting 300-335 touches plus a bigger passing role. Rookie-year letdown is your discount.

4362628.note: Aug 25 knee scare was a minor hyperextension; said he could play the next day. Held out purely as precaution. Draft normally.

4689114.note: 8 top-10 weeks as a rookie in ~12 games. New staff, healthy Nabers, real rushing upside. Best of the QB plateau. Caveat: concussion history from how he runs.

4426338.note: Finished QB11 in points per game even in a down year, age 26. Worth a top-4-round pick in superflex.

4242335.note: Was RB2 per game with Daniel Jones healthy, RB22 without him. Jones returns from an Achilles tear. Huge range of outcomes.

4429160.note: New OC Bobby Slowik plans to run more, but 43% of his PPR value came through the air and Malik Willis rarely checks down. Receiving floor is the risk.
